name: eg2apps
description: EG2Notes and EG2Presentation: offline notes and presentation apps for Even Realities G2 glasses. No network, no server, data stays on the phone.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/eg2notes && tsc -p apps/eg2presentation
scripts.check: npm run check:packages && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:hygiene && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
